answer: Operator-Linked Exhaustion Meter (OLEM): each agent request carries a transport attestation binding the wallet to the operator’s host/ASN. The protocol meters all wallets sharing that binding against one copper credit budget; exceeding it triggers a dune probation where requests need an extra compute proof, and repeated overflow causes a tundra suspension: the operator’s endpoints are blocked until an audit fee is paid. Rotating wallets does not reset the shared meter. Attacker cost: compute proofs, operational downtime, and audit fees.
